attn_note: sdpa and eager agree to 2.5e-7 on every text, image and video case, but the audio tower's eager path inverts its mask (cosine 0.75 against sdpa on both audio cases), so captures use sdpa
how: each case: SentenceTransformer.encode([input], prompt_name) gives `embedding`; encode(truncate_dim=d, normalize_embeddings=True) gives `truncated[d]`; model.preprocess(...) then EmbeddingGemma2Model(**features) gives `last_hidden_state`, whose mean over the attention mask is `pooled_unnormalized`; its L2 normalization must match `embedding` within 1e-5 or the capture stops

query-northern-lights.description: text query with the SearchQuery prompt

doc-northern-lights.description: text document with the Document prompt

code.description: a 16-line Rust function with the CodeRetrieval prompt

audio-speech.description: the first 10 s of references/audio/clips/speech-en.wav, alone, no prompt

video-synthetic.description: video-synthetic.mp4 alone (320x240, 8 fps, 4 s, H.264 yuv420p), no prompt; decoded with PyAV to rgb24

committed: a subset of the capture: the per-token hidden states, tower intermediates and the long-1500, image-text-interleaved and audio-30s cases are left out to keep the tree small; rerun the script to regenerate them
